content:
感谢各位守密人的支持！《忘却前夜》新OST已发布，欢迎收听、下载及分享。
如果有基于OST的二次创作，也欢迎分享给我们！二创请遵照同人规则，OST内容请勿商用。

**忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅**
来吧，孤独的旅人。
在那雪域千峰之巅，有能实现一切愿望的女神，用她的慈爱抚慰所有来客的焦灼与渴望。
别犹豫，沉默的旅人。
如果一场大梦终将消散，就让我们一起化身那场浸润世界的银雨。

✦ 曲：F.R.K. / B.I.A.V. Studio
✦ 企划：B.I.A.V. Studio

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

Thank you for your support!

Morimens new OST was released today. Welcome everyone to listen, download and share.
If you have secondary creations based on the OST, please also share them with us!
 (Please follow the rules of the fandom for secondary creations, and do not use the OST content for commercial purposes)

**Morimens OST┊Crown of the Snowbound Peaks**
Come forth, lonely travelers.
Atop the crown of these snowbound peaks dwells a goddess who grants all desires, soothing the feverish yearning of all who find her with her tender grace.
Falter not, silent travelers.
If this grand dream must ultimately dissolve, let us together become the silver rain that bathes the world.

✦ Composer: F.R.K. / B.I.A.V. Studio
✦ Planning: B.I.A.V. Studio
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**01. 经幡缭绕-Fluttering Prayer Flags**
经幡在风雪中翻滚，旅人的心愿伴随着桑枝燃烧的缕缕青烟，升上雪山之巅。
愿雪山女神宽容所有的亵渎者。

Prayer flags whip through the howling snow. Borne by wisps of pale smoke from burning mulberry branches, the wishes of travelers ascend to the peak.
May the Mountain Goddess forgive all who desecrate her sanctuary.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**02. 仙女宣言-Fairy's Decree**
小小的仙女蹦蹦跳跳地站上所有看客的视线焦点：要想实现所有愿望，就跟着仙女来吧！
The little fairy skips into the spotlight, basking in every onlooker's gaze: 'If you want all your wishes to come true, just follow the fairy!'
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**03. 黄金雨-Golden Rain**
哗啦——哗啦——
多么悦耳的声音！
它就这么哗啦哗啦下进漆黑的地底，也下进所有人心底。

Clink... clink... What a sweet, melodic sound!
Down and down it pours, into the pitch-black earth—and straight into the depths of every heart.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**04. 山的拒绝-The Mountain's Denial**
突如其来的暴风雪，昭示了山的拒绝。
当山吐露它的心声，请敬畏自然吧，否则，它将展示它的威力。

A sudden, violent blizzard heralds the mountain’s denial.
When the peaks lay bare their heart, look upon them with awe—lest they show you the true terror of their wrath.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**05. 假作真时-The False Made Real**
诱骗者说出的话语是真是假？最好别去追究。
若你执着于辨析，就踏入了她的陷阱。

Are the deceiver's words truth or lies? It is best not to seek the answer. For the moment you strive to tell them apart, you have already fallen into her trap.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**06. 夜话-Night Whispers**
嘘。别惊动它。
这一小片窄而短促的光阴，是我们在这漫漫长夜中唯一握得住的东西。

Hush. Do not disturb.
This fleeting, fragile sliver of time is the only thing we can hold fast to in this endless night.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**07. 宇宙二重唱-Cosmic Duet**
宇宙何止千年万年，荒星何止千里万里。
两个世界的两个她，隔着宛如明月的湖面，遥遥对唱。

The cosmos spans eons; desolate stars lie countless leagues apart. Yet two versions of her, from two different worlds, sing to one another across the moonlit mirror of the lake.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**08. 风声缠绵-Lingering Winds**
风啊，请你别带来爱人的呼唤。那是无法抵御的诱惑，无法克制的追寻，那是无从逃避的陷阱。
风啊，请你别带走爱人的声音。请让它再次盘旋在我的耳畔，哪怕分秒，哪怕瞬息。我愿在此永恒栖居。

O wind, do not carry my lover's call to me. It is an irresistible temptation, a relentless pursuit, a trap from which there is no escape.
O wind, do not steal my lover's voice away. Let it linger in my ears once more, if only for a fleeting second, a mere breath. Here, I would gladly dwell forever.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**09. 无罪之羽-Sinless Feather**
诞生于原罪之人啊，请勿跨越那条河流。
溯源而行，逆流而上，我们都降生于同一片无罪的乐土。

You who are born of original sin, do not cross that river. Trace the waters back, journeying against the current, and you will find we were all born of the same sinless pure land.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**10. 冲顶时刻-The Summit Hour**
人类究竟为何会向往徒劳的攀登？那空无一物的尖峰之上，究竟有什么在诱惑着攀登者前仆后继？
或许，只有踏上巅峰的时刻，才能揭晓了。

Why do mortals yearn for such futile climbs? Atop those barren, empty peaks, what is it that lures climbers to cast themselves forward, wave after wave? Perhaps only when one stands upon the summit will the answer be revealed.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**11. 信任诅咒-Trust's Curse**
信任是一种诅咒，你永远不知道那只主动伸出的手会迎来友善的交握还是警惕的刀锋。
Trust is a curse. You can never know if a hand offered to you comes in warm friendship, or conceals a guarded blade.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**12. 潜规则-The Unspoken Rule**
谎言和谎言之间有什么区别？小小的蠕虫分不清楚。
毕竟，在那个天寒地冻，只有总被天花板漏水浇熄的壁炉的家里，从来没有人教授过她语言的潜规则。

What difference lies between one untruth and another? The little worm cannot tell. After all, in a freezing home where the hearth was constantly snuffed out by a leaking ceiling, no one had ever taught her the *unspoken rules of language.*
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**13. 人间圆满-Earthly Fulfillment**
人间圆满，从来不在千峰之巅，而在小窗之内，阖家团圆。
Earthly fulfillment is never found atop a thousand peaks. It is found behind a small window, bathed in the warmth of a family reunited.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**14. 兔子洞-The Rabbit Hole**
兔子是凶猛的生物。可爱的外表下，隐藏着暴烈的脾气。
可惜，很少有人在近距离接触之前清楚这一点。

Rabbits are vicious creatures. Beneath their adorable guise lies a violent, savage temper. Sadly, few realize this until they are already within arm's reach.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**15. 刀与蜜-Blade and Honey**
刀握在手中，赐予你获得自由的能力；
蜜抹在口上，是你独自生活下去的方法。
无论处在人生的哪个阶段，别忘记「前辈」的叮嘱。

The blade in your hand gives you the strength to win your freedom; the honey on your lips is your tool to survive alone.
No matter where life takes you, never forget your "mentor"'s words.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**16. 编号I-1021-Designation I-1021**
编号I-1021，属于亡者的数字。
在弥萨格图书馆，翻开新一页历史，用羽毛笔写下笔记的时刻，都有一些名字正在陈旧的记录中悄悄流逝。

Designation I-1021: a number belonging to the dead.
In the Mythag Library, even as a new page of history is turned and notes are penned in quill, certain names are quietly slipping away from the fading archives.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**17. 七重礼拜-Sevenfold Rite**
七重礼拜，三重宣誓。
从今日起，你的灵魂归属于山，你的心跳与山同频共振。
你不能再有任何属于自己的东西。
哪怕只是一个念头。

Sevenfold Rites. Threefold Vows.
From this day forth, your soul belongs to the mountain, your heartbeat pulsing in lockstep with the peaks.
You must possess nothing of your own.
Not even a single thought.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**18. 新月高悬-Crescent Aloft**
新月高悬，命定的时刻即将降临。
剖开祂的躯壳，让心肺化作洪流，淹没这摇摇欲坠的世界。

The crescent moon hangs high; the hour of fate draws near.
Tear open Its flesh and bone, and let His lifeblood become a deluge to drown this crumbling world.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks

content:
**19. 谎言的余烬-Embers of Lies**
当谎言破碎消散，梦境化为烟尘……
那飘洒的余烬，就是我们存在过的唯一证明。

When lies shatter into nothingness and dreams dissolve to smoke... those drifting embers are the only proof that we once existed.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：雪域千峰之巅┊Morimens OST: Crown of the Snowbound Peaks
